commit_message: Add bounded managed source repair loop
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0131 first-release agent contracts
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0131 first-release completion by re-entering the existing external AgentRuntime after engine-managed source validation failures. The same isolated code workspace is reused, bounded managed failure context is injected, and each repair returns through managed validation.

Autonomous source repair is limited to two attempts and is triggered only for host-owned source-validation failures; proposal scope and permission boundaries remain unchanged.
